seams.description: endpoint reads through the cache to the profile store; a cache hit must skip the store call

omitted_kinds.reason: This 2-leaf Stage freezes only two small contracts (C1 endpoint shape, C2 cache interface) and gate E1 exercises both end to end against the real modules; a separate read-only consistency sweep would add a serial hop without new coverage

The S1 wiring surface already exists in the repo (router registration in app/main.py, store double in tests/conftest.py); this Stage only adds the new route and cache modules next to existing files and creates no new production wiring between existing components

e2e_gates.scenario: two GETs for the same profile id: the first hits the store, the second is served from the cache, and the store is called exactly once; a store outage returns 503 error.code 'store_unavailable'
